method: V17 track method on the V18 song: purse=1 on u/ü vowels and ou/ao/iu diphthong tails (small round protruded opening); teeth=1 with jaw 0.12 on s/z/c/sh/zh/ch/r/j/q/x consonant segments; b/p/m seal releases to the vowel target within 40ms; consonant segment 25%/<=120ms, 40% coarticulation, diphthong slides, silence eases jaw to 0 over 100ms with 200ms hold frames; jaw scaled by V14 anti-vibrato amplitude; 10ms grid
